detailed_descriptions_html.en:
This is not just a game. This is ultra-realistic training. Now with multiplayer!

Ukrainian Fight Drone Simulator (UFDS) is built on real frontline experience and used for training combat drone anf FPV operators. Now with fully released multiplayer, our simulator delivers the closest possible experience to real-world drone operations right at home!

! We recommend using an RC controller ! to build the correct muscle memory, though PS5 and Xbox gamepads are also supported.

WHY UFDS IS DIFFERENT

UFDS is not about arcade or racing-only games, it is about fine motor skills and accurate targeting under pressure.

  • Realistic physics: weight, thrust, battery, aerodynamics

  • Combat conditions: not racing, not freestyle but survival

  • No simplifications: every mistake has consequences

  • Built with input from real operators who serve on the frontline

MULTIPLAYER IS LIVE!

Real FPV operators don’t work alone and neither do you:

  • PvP combat: outplay real opponents

  • Co-op missions: coordinate like a real team

Test your skill, communication and reaction time in a team! 

UFDS Starter Edition on Steam is intended for personal use by hobbyists and drone enthusiasts only. It cannot be used in pilot training centers or for other commercial purposes. Please, contact the developers if you have any questions or concerns.

UFDS MODES: 

  • ACADEMY, which includes Basic pilot course, Kamikaze, Bomber and Air interceptor courses, as well as Racing. Only realistic training scenarios, close-to-real pre-flight procedures.Built to develop real skills, not casual play.

  • BATTLEGROUND with its endless enemy waves, as well as limited drones and resources. Here you train to make tactical decisions under pressure and get to the top of the leaderboard of the FPV simulator.

  • MULTIPLAYER offers PvP racing and co-op Battleground missions.

KEY FEATURES:

  • Deep simulation: Precise calculations in physics, aerodynamics, and battery performance deliver an authentic, close-to-real flight experience.

  • Combat-proven drones: Angel Arrow 12”, Angel Arrow 15”, LuckyStrike, 1M-BA, Mimic 3T, FPV Kamikaze Phantom 7–10”, Dzhmil. 

  • Weapons and payloads: multiple bomb types and modular attachments.

  • Flight controls: PID tuning.

Have you already flown dozens of hours in Liftoff and are looking for something fresh and new? Try the Ukrainian Fight Drone Simulator built by Ukraine’s drone veterans. Fly real battle missions, sharpen your drone mastery and train risk-free!
